Subject: Reprioritizing AI work — please release our demo slot

Hi Sean,

Quick update from our side: leadership just pushed a product sprint that pulls most of the squad you were going to meet with into a feature freeze through the end of the quarter. Given that, we've decided to deprioritize the inference/LLM exploration for now and won't be able to proceed with the demo on Oct 5.

Can you please release the slot and mark this opportunity as paused? We expect to revisit later in Q1 (likely January) once the feature rollout settles. I'm attaching a short deck with the re-prioritization notes for context.

A couple of asks:
- Can you keep us on a short waitlist and ping us in early Jan?
- If you have any one-pager or ROI note tailored to a deprioritized prospect, that would be helpful for the stakeholders when we revisit.

Sorry for the churn — not a reflection on Redwood, just timing on our roadmap.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Senior PM, Novacorp

Totally understand, and thanks for the heads up (and for the deck). We'll release the Oct 5 demo slot and mark the opportunity as paused in our system. I'll add a note to follow up in early January.

I'll loop in Marissa on the ops side so we update the deal stage and free up the demo slot.
